Cc: AVWorks (on-site) <av-techs@avworks.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 07:20:00 -0700
Subject: Booth B12 - internet down; small crack in sponsor arch truss

Hi Jasmine / Marissa,

Quick heads-up from the floor: we just lost wired internet to Booth B12 (NextWave Media) and security found a hairline crack on one of the arch truss plates near the main sponsor arch. No injuries, but the structural team flagged it and cordoned off a 10-ft radius.

Actions we took:
- Isolated power to the affected overhead (no sparking).
- Security taped and posted a hold notice.
- On-site rigging says the crack is in a secondary plate; they recommend shoring and full replacement this afternoon.

Questions for you: can Redwood confirm whether we should move demo equipment off B12 now or wait for AV to implement a 4G failover? NextWave's keynote speaker, Dr. Priya Rao, is scheduled in 90 minutes — they asked whether she can present remotely if AV can't restore connectivity.

Attaching a quick photo for context: site_photos_truss.jpg (image).

Lauren
Venue Operations Manager
Harbor Venues

Subject: Re: Booth B12 - internet down; small crack in sponsor arch truss

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the quick flag and photo.

Immediate plan (short window):
1) Telepresence for keynote: Ben / NextWave — please confirm we can run Dr. Priya remotely from the greenroom (we'll route her feed through an internal hotspot + AV encoder). Ben, if you can confirm acceptance and announce a 10-minute contingency start window, we'll proceed.
2) AV 4G failover + battery: AVWorks, please prioritize portable cellular failover for B12 and the mic/encoder for the keynote. If they have an encoder only but no uplink, prioritize uplink for the keynote feed.
3) Demo swap: Tessa — please mobilize Booth H4 as an immediate demo fallback (power & tabletop are available) and prep a volunteer to move critical demo units.
4) Safety hold: Marissa, please sign off if rigging can do temporary shoring to keep the area safe until full plate replacement. If not, we will have to move hardware off the footprint immediately.

I'll offer NextWave a temporary 15% sponsorship credit for any interruption (we can reconcile later) — Ben, can you confirm that authorization or should I ask finance?

Attaching the onsite AV runbook we use for 4G fallbacks (av_runbook_v2.pdf).

Quick final update — closing the loop for the day:

What happened: truss plate had a hairline crack discovered at 07:15; security cordoned the area and we pulled power as a precaution. Wired internet had an unrelated disruption in the riser affecting B12.

What we did:
- AVWorks deployed a cellular failover and encoder at 07:52 and brought the telepresence kit to the greenroom.
- Dr. Priya Rao presented remotely from the greenroom; AV routed the feed to the ballroom and the keynote completed with no content loss.
- Tessa moved critical demo pieces to Booth H4; booth staff remained with NextWave in a nearby staging area.
- Rigging replaced the plate at 13:10 and cleared the footprint at 13:35.

Attachments uploaded to the incident folder: site_photos_truss.jpg, telepresence_kit_inventory.csv. Lauren — thanks for the incident form; adding to the folder.

Ben, please send a short sponsor note with the offer (15% credit) and a thank-you for patience; copy me when you send it.

If there are follow-ups needed for insurance or a formal incident report, flag them here and I'll coordinate.

Thanks everyone — smooth response.
